name: Garaid

attributes.attribute: was an old warrior of the Fenian Cycle
had his beard and hair tied to his home walls by the women of the court
tore off his own scalp and burned the women to death

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Garaid was an Irish hero of the Fenian Cycle. He was an old warrior. The women of Fionn mac Cumhaill's court feared his advances. They tied his beard and hair to the walls while he slept. He woke and tore off his own scalp to free himself. He exploded with fury and burned the house at Drumcree near Mullingar. All the women inside died. He laughed as they died.

okr.objective: Record the Fenian hero Garaid and his deadly fury.
key_results: Place Garaid as an old warrior of the Fenian Cycle.
Describe the women tying his beard and hair to the walls.
